moments.author: Daniel Lewis
moments.quote: “The love died when the diligence began.”
moments.why: Founder‑investor “BFFs” turned public feud—this line crystallizes a boardroom collapse that’s now a meme of startup betrayal.

moments.author: v0xium
moments.quote: Described workplace as “soul‑sucking,” sparking anxiety‑coded debate over AI coding overload.
moments.why: Tapped into widespread burnout among devs as AI accelerates workflows—Elon Musk even weighed in.

moments.author: Adam Schefter
moments.quote: Giants QB Jaxson Dart’s knee injury could be season‑ending, he’ll likely need surgery.
moments.why: Instant reaction to a key NFL injury driving massive fan concern and trending “Giants” at #1 on X.

moments.author: TreVeyon Henderson
moments.quote: “Yet, this God given right… is being stripped away by the state.”
moments.why: Patriots RB’s biblical‑framed take on a custody/gender case ignited debate across sports and faith circles.
